vulns.title: checked_shlw overflow guard lets attacker mint liquidity for ~1 token
vulns.root_cause: checked_shlw guards a 64-bit left shift with mask 0xffffffffffffffff << 192 and a strict > comparison; the mask should be 1 << 192 with >=. Values in the unguarded gap let n << 64 silently overflow (returning a wrapped value with overflow=false), so a pool that trusts the result credits enormous liquidity for ~1 token unit and lets the attacker drain reserves.
